answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 75 POA per identity, released only after 13 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 260 fakes must lock 19500 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. A timber that can be verified, a vault that can be measured, and a shale that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
